static_traits.name: Zhou Li
static_traits.family_status: 家庭支持度高，但尚not yet与家人讨论内在恐惧
static_traits.medical_history: 曾在滑雪中摔断手臂，已完全康复；No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能具体描述经历与想法；首次来访略显紧张，但配合度高、愿意探索与Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在与自我not足感以及“我可能永远without法赢得滑雪比赛”的恐惧作斗争，即便我经常获得第二名。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative thoughts are affecting my performance and enjoyment in skiing competitions.
growth_experiences: 一次滑雪事故导致手臂骨折。尽管身体完全康复，但该事件成为心理层面的重要拐点，之后在比赛相关情境中产生持续的恐惧与Self-doubt；近一次接近胜利的比赛仍获第二名，这进一步Reinforcement了“赢not了”的担忧。

core_beliefs: 我have not赢得比赛的天赋
I am not good enough/not够胜任

special_situations.event: 最近一次势均力敌的比赛中获得第二名
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not是第一名，就说明I am not good enough、have not天赋
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过更严格的自我要求与可视化训练来试图提升表现以赢得冠军
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 你又失败了；第二名not算什么

special_situations.event: 每次比赛开始前的准备阶段
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果赛前出现恐惧和怀疑，说明我not适合这项运动、最终也赢not了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly thinks it over before competitions and talks with peers to seek confirmation, but still insists on 'whether to win the championship' as the only criterion
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远赢not了；我have not天赋

special_situations.event: 想到自己在滑雪的not yet来时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not yet来not能成为冠军，那么现在的努力都have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将目标单一地聚焦在“必须夺冠”，忽略过程中的成就与进步
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果赢not了，努力have not意义

special_situations.event: 家人和队友对最近比赛的积极反馈与肯定
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not夺冠，他人的称赞not算数、not能说明我足够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 质疑他人的评价，只以名次作为衡量标准
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是安慰我；第二名not值得被称赞

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为“胜者”，证明自己有能力与天赋
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被认为not够好，担心永远without法赢得比赛
defense_goal: 通过维持严格的二元化标准（not赢即失败）与自我苛责来试图掌控not确定性、降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的竞争者、随时可能失败的人
object_relations.object_representation: 善意但without法真正理解自己内在挣扎的他人（家人/队友）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师鼓励其关注积极面并重构对第二名的看法时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为“not赢就not值得被肯定”，把第二名视为失败（移情：把外界肯定视为not真实）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用探询式、温和支持的语气，先Empathy其对“失败”的主观体验，再逐步引导其区分事实与解释、回到具体证据与进步指标。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被问及是否愿意与支持性的家人讨论比赛恐惧时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心家人without法理解或会弱化她的感受，因而选择not表达
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以安全、非评判的方式邀请其识do not被Repression的情绪与需要，use温和开放式问题，允许沉默，鼓励以“我感到……”的陈述练习逐步表达。

manifestations: 在获得第二名后反复出现“如果赢not了，努力have not意义”的想法
把胜负视为唯一价值，忽略过程与成长
outcomes: 比赛的Reduced sense of enjoyment、动力受损

manifestations: 拥有支持性家庭但not与其讨论内在恐惧与Self-doubt
在团队积极反馈下仍难以接纳认可，内在体验与外界评价割裂
outcomes: 主观支持感低于客观支持水平
Continuing self-doubt、负性自我评价维持

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“必须夺冠才算好”为绝对标准
Internalizes 'second place = failure' as a self-judgment rule, ignoring other positive evidence (such as improved personal records)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向家人表达恐惧与担忧，将压力与自责Turning against the self
在Anxiety时更自我批评而非寻求外部支持

positive_force: 在高水平竞争中多次获得第二名，具备稳定竞技水平
赛后能识do not到个人纪录提升与进步
主动寻求咨询、尝试可视化与与同伴交流
negative_force: 非黑即白的完美化标准（not赢即失败）
过度概括与心理过滤，忽略积极证据
对“永远赢not了”的持续担忧与情绪化推理
Sleep disorder与Anxiety导致状态与表现受损

target_behavior.behavior: 赛前及赛后出现强烈的Self-denial性自动思维与Anxiety
antecedent: 比赛结束后尤其是获得第二名时
想到自己的滑雪职业not yet来时
target_behavior.core_reason: After the history of a skiing injury became a psychological turning point, the rigid evaluative standard 'I must win the championship' formed, accompanied by overgeneralization, mental filtering, and black-and-white thinking, leading to catastrophic interpretations of one's own ability
target_behavior.function: 逃避与压制not确定性与失败感，试图通过自我苛责来维持控制与动力
target_behavior.consequence: 比赛享受度下降、表现受影响，Anxiety intensified并持续，Reinforcement负性自我概念

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disorder（因担忧“永远赢not了”与Self-denial思想入睡困难）
antecedent: 夜间反复思考“赢not了”的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessive worry about failure and cognitive biases (mental filtering, overgeneralization, black-and-white thinking) cause high arousal and persistent rumination
target_behavior.function: 在主观上试图通过思考与预演来获得控制感，但实际加重Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality、白天疲惫与Increased anxiety，进一步影响训练与比赛表现
